output_list.criticism: The transfer and transferFrom functions do not check if the receiver's balance is sufficient before transferring tokens, which can lead to an overflow and potentially freeze funds.
The setAIRDROPBounce function allows the owner to set a very high value for AIRDROPBounce, which can be exploited to drain funds.
The setICORatio function allows the owner to set a very low value for ICORatio, which can be exploited to buy tokens at a very low price and drain funds.
The setMINfinney function allows the owner to set a very low value for MINfinney, which can be exploited to buy tokens at a very low price and drain funds.
